g.text: Figure S2 | Objective response and disease control
Bars: proportions ± 1 binomial SE. Labels: responders/total patients. Within-group Fisher exact tests.
Interaction: log(OR B / OR NB) Wald test. Missing/NE remain in primary denominators; evaluable sensitivity in CSV.
